### Why Baidyanath?

##### Asking the right questions—for 100+ years

Relentlessly questioning, continuously evolving—for over a century. At Baidyanath, every product carries the weight of 100+ years of Ayurvedic excellence. While our formulations may not speak, they echo the wisdom of generations. Until innovation allows our products to answer your questions in real-time, we ensure every solution begins with the right inquiry—and ends in potent, proven care. Here's what we never stop questioning…

### Source

##### Where does true purity begin?

We believe it starts at the origin. Our herbs are sourced directly from nature—freshly collected from pristine, native regions across India. Our sourcing is intentional, ethical, and deeply rooted in ancient Ayurvedic tradition. Because purity isn’t an option—it’s our legacy

### Formulation

##### Can tradition evolve with science?

Absolutely. Each Baidyanath formulation is a bridge between timeless Ayurvedic intelligence and contemporary expertise. With meticulously researched blends, our products are crafted by Ayurvedic Experts, for Your everyday need—offering potency, balance, and consistency in every use

### Efficacy

##### Complete Wellness Support?

Yes—and we’ve got proof. With WHO-GMP certification, GMP standards, our products are safe, effective, and trusted. Plus, they’re cruelty-free, freshly made & 100% natural because providing the best quality to you is our tradition.

## Consult Our Free Vaidya

Are you unsure which Ayurvedic solution is right for you? Talk to our trusted Vaidyas for personalised, holistic guidance rooted in 100+ years of Baidyanath’s Ayurvedic legacy. Whether it's digestion, immunity, or skin concerns, our experts offer time-tested insights customised to your unique dosha and lifestyle. 

## What are the Doshas?

According to Ayurveda, the human body is governed by three primary bio-energies known as doshas—Vata, Pitta, and Kapha. Each individual is born with a distinct proportion of these doshas, forming a personal constitution or prakriti, which remains consistent throughout life.

 

### Vata

Governed by the elements of air and ether, Vata represents motion, creativity, and communication.

 

### Pitta

Comprising earth and water, Kapha reflects stability, compassion, and endurance.

 

### Kapha

Kapha dosha is comprised of water and earth. It is associated with structure and atability, as well as patience, compassing, and love.

About Us

Baidyanath has been a symbol of trust, purity, and holistic wellness, and one of the most respected names in Ayurvedic health care in India for over a hundred years. Set up in 1917, Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan Pvt. Ltd. was founded with an eternal vision of introducing the healing power of Ayurveda to every home and every heart.

The Essence of Ayurveda

India discovered a complete life science system Ayurveda, long before the advent of modern medicine. Ayurveda originates from the Sanskrit words Ayu (life) and Veda (knowledge); its approach to health emphasizes balance among the body, mind, and soul.

Ayurveda, which is over 5,000 years old, emphasizes balance, natural healing and prevention. It also utilizes the nature’s healing abilities- herbs, roots, seeds, flowers, minerals, and fruits in the form of specific formulations to maintain the body and restore it to health.

At Baidyanath, this philosophy continues to guide every formulation. Developed by blendingmodern healthcare needs with traditional wisdom, the company employs rigorous scientific validation, advanced manufacturing standards, and strict quality control to ensure Ayurveda remains relevant and effective in the modern world, 

The Founding Vision

Baidyanath originated in 1917 when two visionary brothers Vaidya Pandit Ram Narayan Sharma and Pandit Ram Dayal Joshi, founded Shree Baidyanath Ayurved Bhawan at Baidyanath Dham in Bihar. Their philosophy was profound yet simple:

DeshkiMitti, DeshkiHawa, DeshkaPaani, and DeshkiDawa.

With this conviction, they began preparing authentic Ayurvedic medicines guided by ancient texts such as the Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita and Ashtanga Hridaya. They aimed to make Ayurveda accessible to everyone-not as an alternative, but as a primary way of healthy living.

Over the decades, This vision has made Baidyanath a household name- synonymous with authenticity, quality, and reliability and has earned the trust of millions across India and beyond.
